correctness.rationale: A word’s eight read multiplicities are edge counts of a walk in the 4-vertex order-two binary de Bruijn digraph. Euler existence requires weak connectedness of positive support and exactly one of 13 allowable 0 or start−end imbalance vectors, with no multiplicity for alternative trails. Splitting the six nonloop arcs from 000/111 loops, support inclusion–exclusion and three free integral flow parameters gives rational geometric series. The text provides explicit C_T coefficients, sums and a degree ≤28 bound for D0(z)H(z), with D0=(1−z)^3(1−z²)(1−z³)(1−z⁴). Independently recomputed all Euler-flow counts and compared all GF coefficients through degree 40; the explicitly derived polynomial degree ceiling 28 then turns that agreement into a certificate, not an inference from a finite word list. Independent literal enumeration of 2^n binary strings for n=2..13 matched first 12 predicted counts 1,8,15,28,52,92,151,240,363,532,757,1048. Cyclotomic noncancellation implies minimal quasipolynomial period 12 and leading 13 n^4/288.

originality.rationale: Kiah–Puleo–Milenkovic 2014/2015 give the exact read-profile observation model, Ehrhart framework and a 1/288 closed/balanced-flow asymptotic constant. They do not supply the full open Euler-trail profile enumerator or the claimed explicit rational GF in inspected sections; the 13 possible imbalances explain why the leading constant here is 13/288. Jacquet–Knessl–Szpankowski give Markov type asymptotics, and a published binary read-length-two census is not the read-length-three answer. The 2012 expanded Markov type journal version remains a priority risk.

value.rationale: The count is exactly the maximum error-free code size for complete unordered multiplicity-preserving binary 3-gram reads, a reconstruction invariant singled out by DNA sequence-profile literature. All-length explicit GF, sharp quasipolynomial period and 13/288 leading constant go beyond the known restricted balanced counts and general rationality; motivated exact combinatorial problem rather than an arbitrary coefficient slice.

limitations: Only unrestricted binary linear words, complete overlapping 3-read multiset, error-free; not all q-ary k-gram profiles or noisy sequencing.
